items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 September 2026 5:38am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 22 September 2026 at 5:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the southwest of England.


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering Northwest 5 to 7 overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building moderate later.


##Weather##

Occasional drizzle at first, with a risk of mist and fog patches. Becoming fair for a time, then rain overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist and very poor in any fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 5 or 6 occasionally 7 at first, soon decreasing 4 or 5, becoming south or southeast 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, possibly rough in places at first, becoming smooth or slight later.


##Weather##

Rain at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first.
